note: Hard caps on the AI steps of one film (docs/content/FILM_LINE.md). Tokens are cost-weighted: input x1, cache write x1.25, cache read x0.1, output x5. A step is stopped the moment it spends its budget; a film stops starting AI steps once its total is spent.

plan.note: the decide step: one reply (no tools, no session load) to plan-brief.md with every shot's decisions; G02's 252 shots measured 163k (2026-10-07)

pick.note: only the picture shots the filters could not rank

fix.note: a reply: the validator's remaining problems and the shots they name, field patches back (plan_brief.fix_brief)

review.note: one look at the review sheets once film-qa is clean

script.note: a script draft for the founder's review

runner.note: the unattended content runner (scripts/content-tick.sh): each 30-minute tick is one capped session; a tick past the day's or the week's cap does not start
